title: Sequence the mailbox clients, then docs, then photos and phone backup

costar.context: The maintainer asked for webmail and a phone-width version, a commercial cloud deployment, an enterprise-only control plane, then docs, then photos sync and phone backup.
costar.objective: Record that sequence on the surfaces this server already serves, without starting the clients during the deployable-image phase.
costar.style: One product rule section and four roadmap phases that stay not_started.
costar.audience: The next coding agent and the maintainer.
costar.response: Web and phone mailbox clients use JMAP, CalDAV, and CardDAV after shippin.cloud hosts the image. The control plane stays the existing directory and is enterprise-only. Docs connect later. Photos and phone backup use file nodes.

concerns: Starting a webmail client before the deployable image is hosted would skip the current phase.
A new Go control plane would be a second product. The directory, SCIM, and registry are the control plane.
Photos and phone backup need a new store only if file nodes cannot hold the blobs. FileNode already has a blob hash, size, and media type.
context: Two nodes already shared a mailbox. The deployable image is in progress. The maintainer wants the client sequence written down so functionality comes before docs, and docs before photos and phone backup.
current_state: JMAP mail, CalDAV, CardDAV, web push, email push, and urn:ietf:params:jmap:filenode exist. deployable-product is in_progress. No web client, document editor, or phone-backup client is in this repository.
target_design: After shippin.cloud hosts the image, one client family serves the mailbox at desktop width and phone width. The control plane is the existing directory and is limited to white-label and enterprise licensing. Documents are a later connected product. Photos sync and phone backup are a later client on file nodes.
changes: Restate zoho-client as the web and phone mailbox.
Add enterprise-control, docs, and photos-phone phases after that client, all not_started.
boundaries: Do not build the web client in this pass.
Do not add a Go control plane or a license checker that accepts keys.
Do not add a document editor or a new blob store.
Do not remove rocks from the one-node build.
